meta.title: Official Tender Specifications for PP-R Piping Systems
meta.desc: Download detailed K-Aqua tender specifications. We provide uncompromising safety through German Engineering for your global megaprojects.

items.title: The Definition of Perfection.
items.text: The process begins in MEP planning. Exact definition of nominal diameters, pressure ratings (PN), and SDR classes for hot and cold water. We leave no gray areas. Every fitting, every clamp, every socket is recorded with mathematical precision.

items.title: Submission Without Compromise.
items.text: Due to the granular, crystal-clear structure of our texts, offers become truly comparable. Dumping prices due to inferior materials or hidden omissions are immediately apparent. The wheat is separated from the chaff.

items.title: A Blueprint for the Construction Site.
items.text: The tender specifications serve as a binding legal code for site management and installers. Every weld seam, every fixation must comply with the specified DVS guidelines. Deviations are made impossible.

items.title: 50+ Years Absolute Maintenance Freedom.
items.text: The result of a flawless specification is a system that is flawless for decades. Maximum resilience against corrosion, incrustation, and chemical degradation. Cross-generational safety, engineered in Germany.

timeline.title: From Tender to Eternity.
timeline.desc: A tender specification from K Aqua is not just a document. It is the source code for built reality. It defines, protects, and dictates the entire lifecycle of a building, from the first sketch to decades of use.

hero.desc: Architecture begins with a thought. Engineering begins with a specification. Our tender specifications are the legally binding foundation for water infrastructure without compromise. Millimeter-precise. VOB-compliant. Unassailable.

manifesto.p1: In building architecture and industrial plant construction, vague phrasing is the greatest existential risk. A single imprecise word in the service description can mean the difference between a system that is maintenance-free for decades and catastrophic water damage in a 50-story high-rise.
manifesto.p2: That is why we don't just write tender specifications, we engineer them. Like every single K Aqua pipe section, our digital data packages are developed in Germany, tested and proven under extreme conditions. They translate physical superiority into legal and economic unassailability.

bento.title: Specifications That Protect.
bento.lead: Developed for MEP specialist planners, architects, and visionary engineers who cannot tolerate errors when planning billion-dollar projects.

items.desc: From the complex fitting to the shut-off valve to the thermodynamic mounting clamp: the complete coverage of the entire ecosystem prevents expensive supplementary claims.

grid.title: The Anatomy of a Service Item.
grid.desc: We leave nothing to chance. Every service item is a masterpiece of German engineering, compressed into text form. Here is what our texts cover in detail:

items.title: Pipe Systems SDR 6 / SDR 7.4
items.desc: PN 20. Fiber composite technology with integrated linear expansion minimization for maximum dimensional stability.

items.title: Electrofusion Sockets
items.desc: Fully automated welding documentation and 100% homogeneous, inseparable, and leak-proof connections.

items.title: Transition Fittings
items.desc: Dezincification-resistant premium brass (DZR), permanently and inseparably cast into the PP-R matrix.

items.title: Shut-off Valves
items.desc: Maintenance-free ball and inclined seat valves, flow-optimised and dead space-minimized for legionella prevention.

items.title: Manifold Systems
items.desc: Modular, high-capacity manifolds for complex risers and floor connections in large projects.

items.title: Insulation according to GEG
items.desc: Integrated specifications for strict avoidance of heat loss and condensation formation (falling below the dew point).

items.title: Fire Protection Collars
items.desc: R90/R120 compliant, highly reactive penetration seal systems for safe wall and ceiling penetrations.

items.title: System Fixings
items.desc: Precise fixed and sliding point specifications for the controlled absorption of thermal linear expansion.

cta.title: Start with the specification.
cta.desc: Access our complete, constantly updated library of tender specifications. Guaranteed error-free, standard-compliant, and ready for use in your next international megaproject.

items.title: Absolute Legal Certainty (VOB/C)
items.desc: In the planning of international megaprojects, ambiguity is the enemy. A single missing word in the service description can mean the difference between a system that is maintenance-free for decades and a disastrous million-dollar damage. Our tender specifications are standardized with millimeter precision according to VOB/C and DIN 18381. Every service description is calibrated to completely eliminate technical loopholes, interpretation margins, and legal gray areas. Thus we guarantee that the quality you specify on paper is exactly the quality that is installed on the construction site.

items.title: 100% GAEB & ÖNORM Compatibility
items.desc: A modern planning process requires seamless data flow. Our data sets are not just text; they are highly structured, machine-readable artifacts designed for immediate integration into any professional AVA software (tendering, awarding, accounting). We deliver native formats (GAEB 90, GAEB 2000, GAEB DA XML) as well as Datanorm and ÖNORM. No conversion losses. No manual rework effort. A digital workflow that increases efficiency in the planning process by up to 40% while mathematically eliminating transmission errors.

items.title: The Material Specification: PPR-C (Type 3)
items.desc: Water infrastructure is the nervous system of a building. Our service items clearly and unmistakably define the superior molecular structure of our Polypropylene Random Copolymer (PPR-C Type 3). They fix decisive parameters such as creep rupture strength, creep behavior, and thermal linear expansion. Only through this uncompromising depth of detail do you effectively protect your project from inferior derivatives and dangerous counterfeits that would inevitably surrender at peak pressures of 20 bar or temperature fluctuations.

items.title: Thermodynamic and Acoustic Precision
items.desc: Premium architecture demands premium physics. A professional tender covers not only the bare piping system but the entire physical ecosystem. Our texts contain detailed specifications on heat loss coefficients according to the Building Energy Act (GEG) / EnEV as well as strict sound insulation values (DIN 4109). This ensures that your system is not only mechanically extremely resilient but also highly thermodynamically efficient and acoustically operates in the absolute premium segment (whisper standard).

items.title: Sustainability Metrics (ESG & LEED)
items.desc: The future of construction is circular and CO2-optimised. Tenders today must prove green standards. K Aqua texts integrate complete EPDs (Environmental Product Declarations) and life cycle assessments. We define the exact ecological footprint, recyclability, and energy efficiency in extrusion. Perfectly suited for buildings that are to be certified according to DGNB, LEED, BREEAM, or WELL. Specify green performance, not just green promises.
